versions.name: Camp Emerson (Boseker Scout Reservation)

features.note: Swimming and lifesaving instruction at the pool.
A 60-foot climbing tower used for the climbing merit badge.
Environmental science, plant, animal, and insect study.
Basketry, leatherwork, sculpting, and wood carving.
A first-year camper program on the Trail to First Class.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident summer camp on Boseker Scout Reservation in the San Jacinto Mountains near Idyllwild, California. Offers merit badge programs in aquatics, shooting sports, and climbing tower, plus Trail to First Class. Also home to Camp Brown and Camp Wiley.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
